existing_checks.scope: Packing-independent ceiling for the selected paid profile under the one-unpaid-coordinate coverage and halving guard.
existing_checks.remaining: A changed word or model requires new pricing; a local packing search must name uncovered scope.

actual_scope: Five explicit cross-call three-role cycles on the pinned PR3308 T16 owner map; each cycle uses three distinct source calls and preserves the selected word and suppliers. No neighborhood or global optimum is claimed.
scope_change_reason: This narrows the selected-packing card to the cross-call three-role domain left open by the prior same-call census. The live PR3338 covers a two-role swap; this witness adds four further priced cycles after reaching the same κ once.
bottleneck_link: The complex supplier binds the selected composition. Repacking its idle ranks lowers the exact complex moment while leaving the already-priced bit supplier unchanged, so the balanced conditional κ rises.
stop_rule: Accept a cycle only when all three role destinations satisfy the exact call windows, group capacity and physical-family occupancy checks and the rebuilt exact supplier prices improve. Do not infer optimality from the five exhibited cycles; stop the fixed-word line at its exact packing ceiling and pursue a changed word or contract for κ above 0.01.
evidence: RESULT.json and evidence/REPLAY.json record the strict global replay at κ=0.001673623729715781; evidence/CHECK.json records the independent owner audit, both supplier prices, selected-word ceiling fraction and exact pricing sweep.
